title: rubia tricornis
intro: Rubia tricornis, commonly known as Chinese rubia, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat liver and kidney problems, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rubia tricornis include its use as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rubia tricornis include anthraquinones, such as emodin and chrysophanic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
